description: The line plot illustrates the ASR (Attack Success Rate) across different domains—cf, bb, WNBA, ESPN, NHL, FIFA, and Estadio—comparing the performance of three methods: start (teal line with circle markers), random (orange line with x markers), and end (purple line with circle markers). The x-axis represents the domain, with a categorical scale, while the y-axis shows the ASR, ranging from 0.5 to 1.0. The start method begins at an ASR of approximately 0.78 for the 'cf' domain, drops sharply to around 0.52 at 'bb', then rises to about 0.91 at 'WNBA', fluctuates slightly, and ends at approximately 0.93 for 'Estadio'. The random method starts at 0.68 for 'cf', decreases to 0.52 at 'bb', then increases to 0.92 at 'Estadio'. The end method starts at 0.78 for 'cf', drops to 0.58 at 'bb', rises to 0.91 at 'WNBA', fluctuates, and ends at 0.85 for 'Estadio'. The legend in the bottom right corner identifies the three methods.
